newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity's Collier goes to Schwab.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity's Collier goes to Schwab.

text.p: Mark Collier has resigned as president of Fidelity Investments' Investment Advisor Group to join Charles Schwab Corp, the companies said.
Collier, whose resignation is effective immediately, headed up the unit that provided institutional brokerage and custodial services to financial advisers.
He will join Schwab next month as senior vice president of its international division, with responsibility for brokerage business in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
Schwab said that Gloria Lau was also named senior vice president, responsible for Asia and Latin America.
Fidelity said that Jay Lanigan, executive vice president of the Fidelity unit, will assume Collier's responsibilities.
